content.comment_body: Hello, I want to achieve the following with my [product_name] [article_no]: I need one button to perform two actions: A) A short press turns the light on, and B) holding the button for about 1 second turns the light on and off again after 5 minutes. I have been searching but haven't found a solution. Thank you.
Alternatively, you might want to try this approach.
I'm having issues uploading the program. Please message me privately and I'll send it directly to you.

Hello, [product_name] files can't be uploaded directly; you need to archive them first. Also, please avoid sharing your email address publicly to reduce spam. For contact, use the Private Messages option on the forum. I've attached an example file for [product_name] to help you get started. Regards,

Thank you so much for the assistance. The solution works with the [product_name] switch: a quick press causes the light to turn off after 5 minutes, and a longer press keeps the light on indefinitely. Turning it off is also simple. Great result, thanks!
